paite: "Pathian aw, kipahthu ka hon hilh uhi; kipahthu ka hon hilh uhi, na min anai ziak in; mi'n na thillamdang hih thute agengen uhi.
heading: Asaph phatna La / Pathian Vaihawmpa

paite: "Hun seh pen ka muh hun chiang in diktak in vai ka hawm ding hi.
Lei leh asung a om tengteng azul khinta, ke'n abante ka phut ahi. Selah
Mi-uangte kiang ah, 'Uangtak in om kei un,' ka chi a, migilou-saloute kiang ah, 'Na kii uh sangsak kei un,' leng ka chi hi.
Na kii uh tunglam ah hihsang kei unla; ngawng golh zen in thu gen kei un.
"Sansakna suahlam a kipan ahi kei a, tumlam a kipan leng ahi kei lai a, simlam a kipan ahi sam kei hi.
Pathian vaihawmpa ahi zaw; ama'n khat niamsak in khat asangsak hi.
TOUPA khut ah nou a om a, a-uain aphul a; thil dang toh hel in adim a, huai a pan abungkhia a; pel lou in aneng nangawn lei a migilou-salou tengteng in adawnsiang sinsin ding uhi.
"Himahleh ke'n zaw tangtawn in ka theisak ding a, Jakob' Pathian phat in la ka sa ding hi.
Migilou-saloute kii tengteng ka hihtan ding a; midiktatte kii zaw sansak in a-om ding hi.
